title: Orbit and Colony
author: Rosalind Reyes
blurb: Silas Amberdale, a pilot bonded to an AI that lies, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. But when a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
